zygotic.text: of or relating to a zygote

zymases.text: a complex of enzymes that cause glycolysis; originally found in yeast but also present in higher organisms

zymogen.text: any of a group of compounds that are inactive precursors of enzymes and require some change (such as the hydrolysis of a fragment that masks an active enzyme) to become active

zymosis.text: a process in which an agent causes an organic substance to break down into simpler substances; especially, the anaerobic breakdown of sugar into alcohol

zymotic.text: of or relating to or causing fermentation

zymurgy.text: the branch of chemistry concerned with fermentation (as in making wine or brewing or distilling)
